label: Sharp, Hook & Button
description: A hook-and-button closure fastens the waistband tab with a concealed metal hook-and-bar backed up by a button, giving a flat, secure front with no visible bulge. The hook takes the strain so the waistband sits smooth and the button adds a backup fixing. It is a clean, quality closure typical of tailored trousers.
